<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>

The problem is that I scrape the diesel price of tomorrow, but the selector is sometimes not available on the website (if there's no price change available, the selector is not there.

If the selector is unavailable, instead of a "0", it logs errors at warning level.

"Index '0' not found in sensor.diesel_morgen"

My scrape sensor looks like this:
```
scrape:
  - resource: https://carbu.com//belgie/diesel
    sensor: 
      - name: Diesel morgen
        select: "#news > div > div:nth-child(1) > table > tbody > tr:nth-child(1) > td:nth-child(3)"
        value_template: >
            {% set state = (value [0:6] | replace(',', '.')) %}
            {% if is_number(state) %}
            {{ state | float }}
            {% else %}
            0
            {% endif %}
        unit_of_measurement: €/l
        availability: false
        unique_id: diesel_morgen
```

In the past, the sensor showed a 0 when it couldn't scrape.
